description: This file defines a PHP class 'AddressFormat' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Localisation'. It serves as a controller in the OpenCart admin panel for managing address formats, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting address format entries. The class interacts with models, views, and handles HTTP requests and responses related to address formatting within the localization module.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: Controller class for managing address formats in the OpenCart admin localisation module, providing CRUD operations and list rendering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the address format list view with appropriate data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles requests to display the address formats list, delegating to getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves address format entries, manages pagination, and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an address format.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or edited address format data via POST requests.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected address format entries, with permission and default checks.
